description: Retrieve a thread of messages posted to a conversation.

channel.description: Conversation ID to fetch thread from.

ts.description: Unique identifier of either a thread's parent message or a message in the thread.

cursor.description: Paginate through collections by setting cursor to next_cursor.

inclusive.description: Include messages with oldest or latest timestamps. Default: false.

latest.description: Only messages before this Unix timestamp will be included. Default: now.

oldest.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp will be included. Default: 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Default: 1000.
